_comment: L2 of docs/2026-09-07_latent_intent_design.zh.md: the latent intent on the control output. BASE = L1's winner (l1_lowdim_20260907): N=32 under simple-v3's own supervision — native segment endpoints, true-time-position, the inverse-dynamics imitation teacher at 64.0 and the velocity term (L1_native32 val ADE 1321 m vs the N=64 baseline's 1333: the width is free; the dense/no-teacher arms sat at 2514/2602 m: the trajectory-error loss alone is NOT enough). The teacher's dose was calibrated at N=64 and matched the baseline unchanged at N=32, so it is kept. Arms differ only in the prior: L2_gauss (K=1, analytic KL), L2_mix4 (K=4 mixture, MC KL). Checkpoint selection stays fixed-anchor-common-grid-ade (the prior top-1 replay, deterministic) because the validation OBJECTIVE is stochastic under a posterior sample. Free bits 0.05 nats/dim, beta 1.0 (no annealing in v1). READOUT: predict every arm with `--latent-samples 6 --latent-random 6 --latent-shuffle` (modes/, random/, shuffled/ beside the top-1 records), then run_ts_latent_readout.py per arm (it reads random/ as the same-K control) and compare_constraint_arms.py for top-1 vs L1_native32 (the base itself, paired on the same 1404 flights; the 1333 m N=64 reference is control_procedure_20260905/A_control_v3) on both metric families. PRE-REGISTERED GATES (design doc §六 L2): (1) not collapsed — history.json latent.active_units >= 3 at the best epoch AND shuffled ΔADE > 200 m pooled; (2) minADE_6 clearly below top-1 AND below the same-K N(0, I) control the readout prints (`ctrl minADE`, from --latent-random 6: K chances at a latent the prior did not choose); (3) top-1 not worse than L1_native32 on every stratum (the latent must not cost the point estimate). VETO: straight-in top-1 FDE degraded beyond seed noise.
